# Home Guide

> Digital property management for estates, landscapes, and living assets — tasks, maps, assets, compost tracking, CRM, and crew tools in a single app.

Home Guide helps estate owners, property managers, and landscaping crews coordinate maintenance work with spatial context (GPS, zones, assets), evidence logs, and a worker marketplace.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview and features for estate and landscape management.
- [Job Board](/jobs): Public marketplace listing landscaping and estate jobs.
- [Sign in](/auth): Account login and signup.

## Optional

- [Worker profile](/worker/:id): Public profile for individual workers in the marketplace.
